entities.name: Ernesto Corripio y Ahumada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ernesto Corripio y Ahumada was a Mexican Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Mexico and Primate of Mexico(1977–1994). He was made a cardinal in 1979.
